dct_description_sm: Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.
Contributors: G.W. & C.B. Colton & Co; Iowa Railroad
Map of the midwestern states showing drainage, township and counties, land grants, railroads with named lines. Includes geographical description and advertising.
Scale Entered according to act of Congress in the year 1857 1:1,250,000.
dct_title_s: Map showing location of lands belonging to the Iowa Rail Road Land Company Iowa Falls, and Sioux City R.R. Land Company Sioux City, and Pacific Land Company & Elkhorn Land Company, J. T. McAlvin, Del. I.R.R. Land Department, Cedar Rapids, Iowa, 1871
